# UCP draft schemas (not released)

| File | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `quote-pr930.json` | `source/schemas/common/quote.json` from [UCP PR #930](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/pull/930), the reference for proposal [#929](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/issues/929) | Open proposal (Working Draft candidate); fetched 2026-11-24 |

Apache-2.0, like the released schemas. The gateway serves its quote extension under its own
namespace until `dev.ucp.common.quote` is released, because `dev.ucp.*` names may only be
published from ucp.dev (UCP authority binding).
